summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a 6-K disclosing that on November 2, 2026 it filed Amendment No. 1 to its Schedule 14D-9 with the SEC in connection with the U.S. Offer. Inversiones Aspi S.A., a Holcim Ltd. subsidiary acting jointly and severally with Holcim, launched a Peruvian subsequent tender offer for the Company's common voting shares, alongside a concurrent U.S. offer addressed to U.S. resident shareholders and ADS holders. The filing is procedural; it names no price, stake, premium or closing date. Watch the board's 14D-9 position, tender thresholds and ADS acceptance mechanics.
